round1_resolution.outcome: declined, accepted as a guide defect rather than a string defect
round1_resolution.evidence: vi ui.chat still reads 'Mở lịch đánh thức trong chi tiết lượt chạy'. Re-measured across src/i18n/catalogues/vi: «lịch đánh thức» 27 occurrences, other «đánh thức» 13, «thức dậy» 2 (both intransitive sentences in unrelated surfaces). The shipped product names the scheduled object «lịch đánh thức», so changing only this pane would split one object across surfaces. Carried as vi-r2-01 so the guide action is not lost.
Now 'Đóng khung bên lề', and the shipped ui.chat.composer.placeholder.aside reads 'Hỏi ngoài bản ghi — Esc đóng khung bên lề', so both files name the panel the same way.

round1_resolution.outcome: declined, accepted for the same product-consistency reason as vi-cs-01
round1_resolution.evidence: vi ui.chat.run_details still reads 'Lịch đánh thức' / 'Hủy lịch đánh thức' / 'Hủy lịch đánh thức: {head}' / 'Hủy lịch đánh thức kích hoạt lúc {due}'. Carried as vi-r2-03.

Now 'Chỉ dẫn được giao' over the folded brief block (run-child-reader.tsx renders it as that block's section label). The passive fragment no longer leaves the reader asking what was handed over, and «chỉ dẫn» is the shipped term for instructions given to an agent.
Now 'Máy chủ này từ chối đăng nhập. Hãy kiểm tra cấu hình của máy chủ.' — the inanimate pronoun «của nó» is gone.
'Đóng bảng câu hỏi' is unchanged. Round 1 itself recorded that keeping «bảng» is acceptable for an accessible name; the addition is a deliberate clarifier, not a meaning error.

'Đã xử lý' is unchanged. It is a heading over the settled half; the longer «đã giải quyết trong cuộc trò chuyện» is a sentence in the receipt line, which is a natural different form, not a contradiction.

findings.problem: Glossary §2 gives vi wake as «thức dậy» and i18n/style-guides/vi.md says «đánh thức» is wrong, but the shipped vi product names the scheduled wake «lịch đánh thức» in 27 values (ui.schedules, ui.agents.refusals and this pane) against «thức dậy» in 2 intransitive sentences. The new string follows the product majority; the guide is the stale side of the conflict.
findings.proposed: Keep the string and record «lịch đánh thức» for the scheduled-wake noun (verb «đánh thức / thức dậy» in prose) in i18n/style-guides/vi.md and in the glossary §2 footnote. If the guide is to be enforced literally instead, change all five wake strings and the schedule surfaces together in a separate wave — never only this pane.
findings.disposition: declined/accepted — carried from vi-cs-01; not gating; guide action requested
